actions.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Energy and Mineral Resources.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal land management agencies, state geological surveys, and mining or mineral exploration companies.
dimensions.evidence: Survey data made publicly available under subsection (b)(3) shall be provided to mining and mineral exploration companies

dimensions.assessment: Mandates specific geophysical surveys, data comparison, and reporting requirements without altering broader mining laws.
dimensions.evidence: carry out a program to conduct original quantum-enhanced geophysical surveys to improve upon existing United States Geological Survey data

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal survey costs, though specific appropriations amounts are not stated in the text.
Directs a specific agency program and interagency coordination for mineral mapping.
dimensions.evidence: To require the Secretary of the Interior to carry out a quantum-enhanced critical minerals survey, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Requires a survey program and a report due within 24 months of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 24 months after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall submit... a report

missing_information: Specific funding amounts authorized or appropriated for the survey program
Exact locations of all survey sites beyond priority western zones
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of the Interior to conduct quantum-enhanced geophysical surveys for critical minerals on or adjacent to federal lands and report to Congress.
